videos.title: Copilot Studio HOOKS Will Make Your AI Agents Predictable
videos.description:
I love the new hooks feature in #CopilotStudio. They are my favorite thing in a long time because they make your agents behaviour more predictable.

What hooks do is make your agent run a workflow when a specific type of event occurs: like the start of a conversation, or the agent selects a tool to be used, or when an error happens.

There are so many good uses cases for this. And today I’m going to show you how to build my favorite ones. Let’s get started.

Table Of Contents 🎬
00:00 Introductio

videos.title: 573 - Deployment pipelines fell off once Git became the standard
videos.description:
573 - Deployment pipelines quietly fell off once Git became the standard in Fabric workspaces. Two flows that never fit together. Deployment plans work more like repo actions, and that's the part worth hearing.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #git #deployment #dataengineering

videos.title: 573 - The parent pipeline fails if the child deploys later
videos.description:
573 - Child pipelines have to exist before the parent deploys, or the parent has nothing to attach to and the deploy fails. That order has been happening on its own, with nobody controlling it.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #devops #datapipelines #deployment

videos.title: 573 - I won't hand people Fabric if I can't turn things off
videos.description:
573 - "I'm not willing to give people Fabric because I can't turn off Dataflows Gen 2." Right now anyone with access can run anything in there. Policies finally change who gets to build what.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #governance #powerbi #dataplatform

videos.title: 573 - Capacity admins can now block who creates Dataflows Gen2
videos.description:
573 - Capacity admins can now say which security groups are allowed to create Dataflows Gen2, and where. Fabric policies in preview move governance off tenant-wide settings. Requests outside the rules get blocked.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #governance #dataplatform #powerbi

videos.title: 573 - Dashboards got a B minus, just above distressed
videos.description:
573 - Dashboards landed at a B minus, one notch above distressed. Four things set the score, and the last one is the question of whether anyone still uses the feature.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #powerbi #dashboards #datatools

videos.title: 573 - Dataflows Gen1 scored higher than Gen2
videos.description:
573 - Dataflows Gen1 beat Gen2 in the ratings, and nobody on the call was shocked. Gen2 has the nicer UI. Efficiency and price point are a different story.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #dataflows #powerbi #dataengineering

videos.title: 573 - I never understood bonds, and the color coding still works
videos.description:
573 - You don't need to know what a bond rating is to read this thing. Higher letter, better product. The color coding does most of the work before you read a single word.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #powerbi #ux #datatools

videos.title: 573 - Fabric features now get a credit rating like bonds
videos.description:
573 - Fabric features now have letter grades, same scale Moody's uses on bonds. AAA means worth your time. The site is live at fabriccreditratings.com, and MVPs are still filling in the gaps.

https://youtu.be/9_ssMBFK9GE

#microsoftfabric #powerbi #dataengineering #fabriccommunity

videos.title: 572 - Q and A, narrative visuals, automated insights all died the same way
videos.description:
572 - Narrative visuals, automated insights, Q and A. All three failed adoption for one reason, and ontology is lining up behind them. An artifact nobody trusts is one nobody uses.

https://youtu.be/3Tyy-ORNsA8

#microsoftfabric #powerbi #ontology #dataculture

videos.title: 572 - Put ontology on a trial capacity, never an F2
videos.description:
572 - Put ontology on your Fabric trial, never on an F2. CU numbers are still coming, but the verdict is in: not ready for prime time, and the MCP route may get you further than the built-in experience.

https://youtu.be/3Tyy-ORNsA8

#microsoftfabric #ontology #fabriccapacity #mcp

videos.title: 572 - Ontology was built UI first, and that's the problem
videos.description:
572 - Skills Vault got built CLI first, so an agent can change anything in it. Ontology feels like the reverse order, which is a strange choice for a feature whose whole point is feeding agents.

https://youtu.be/3Tyy-ORNsA8

#microsoftfabric #ontology #aiagents #apifirst

videos.title: 572 - Anything I can do, the agent should be able to do
videos.description:
572 - Claude reads an email and books three meetings. Copilot in Outlook said it couldn't, so it sat unused for months. If it does something destructive, warn me. Don't hand it half the controls.

https://youtu.be/3Tyy-ORNsA8

#aiagents #copilot #claudecode #microsoft

videos.title: 572 - Close the browser and the agent forgets everything
videos.description:
572 - Work with the ontology agent for hours, refresh your browser, and the whole conversation is gone. No chat history at all, and even a live session has a 24 hour ceiling.

https://youtu.be/3Tyy-ORNsA8

#microsoftfabric #ontology #aiagents #contextwindow
